children.value: Process bulk RNA-seq FASTQ files into aligned reads and expression estimates, then perform cohort-level expression quality control and normalization.
This mini-protocol walks through bulk RNA-seq expression processing.
performs read-level quality assessment, optional adapter trimming, STAR alignment, and gene- or transcript-level quantification.
filters low-expression features and detects sample outliers, and
produces normalized expression matrices for downstream xQTL analysis.

The commands form selectable routes rather than one mandatory chain. Gene-level RNA-SeQC and transcript-level RSEM quantification are alternatives after alignment. The bundled matrix-QC example starts from existing count and TPM matrices, so steps 6–7 can be run independently of the toy FASTQ example in steps 1–5.
Choose a route before running commands.
Same inputs as the STAR route
QC and normalize existing expression matrices
Run only the row matching the intended analysis goal. Adapter trimming is optional; use it when read-level QC or library preparation indicates adapter contamination.
Generate per-sample FastQC reports before alignment.

sos run pipeline/RNA_calling.ipynb fastqc \
    --cwd output/rnaseq/fastqc \
    --sample-list tests/fixtures/rna_calling/protocol_example.rnaseq.fastq.list.txt \
    --data-dir tests/fixtures/rna_calling/fastq
Remove configured adapter sequences and write trimmed FASTQ files for alignment.

sos run pipeline/RNA_calling.ipynb fastp_trim_adaptor \
    --cwd output/rnaseq --sample-list tests/fixtures/rna_calling/protocol_example.rnaseq.fastq.list.txt \
    --data-dir tests/fixtures/rna_calling/fastq --STAR-index <path/to/STAR_Index> \
    --gtf <path/to/Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.103.chr.reformatted.ERCC.gtf> \
    --reference-fasta <path/to/GRCh38_full_analysis_set_plus_decoy_hla.noALT_noHLA_noDecoy_ERCC.fasta> \
    --ref-flat <path/to/Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.103.chr.reformatted.ERCC.ref.flat>

children.label: 3. Align reads with STAR and run Picard QC

children.value: Map reads to the reference genome and calculate alignment-level RNA-seq quality metrics.

sos run pipeline/RNA_calling.ipynb STAR_align \
    --cwd output/rnaseq/bam --sample-list tests/fixtures/rna_calling/protocol_example.rnaseq.fastq.list.txt \
    --data-dir tests/fixtures/rna_calling/fastq --STAR-index <path/to/STAR_Index> \
    --gtf <path/to/Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.103.chr.reformatted.ERCC.gtf> \
    --reference-fasta <path/to/GRCh38_full_analysis_set_plus_decoy_hla.noALT_noHLA_noDecoy_ERCC.fasta> \
    --ref-flat <path/to/Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.103.chr.reformatted.ERCC.ref.flat> \
    --chimSegmentMin 0 \
    -J 50 --mem 200G --numThreads 8
Summarize aligned reads into gene-level expression measurements.

sos run pipeline/RNA_calling.ipynb rnaseqc_call \
    --cwd output/rnaseq/bam \
    --sample-list tests/fixtures/rna_calling/protocol_example.rnaseq.fastq.list.txt \
    --data-dir tests/fixtures/rna_calling/fastq \
    --gtf <path/to/Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.103.chr.reformatted.collapse_only.gene.gtf> \
    --reference-fasta <path/to/GRCh38_full_analysis_set_plus_decoy_hla.noALT_noHLA_noDecoy_ERCC.fasta> \
    --bam_list output/rnaseq/fastqc/sample_bam_list.txt
Estimate transcript- and gene-level abundance using the RSEM reference index.

    --reference-fasta <path/to/GRCh38_full_analysis_set_plus_decoy_hla.noALT_noHLA_noDecoy_ERCC.fasta> \
    --ref-flat <path/to/Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.103.chr.reformatted.ERCC.ref.flat> \
    --bam_list output/rnaseq/fastqc/sample_bam_list.txt \
    --RSEM-index <path/to/RSEM_Index>

Tracked cohort-level examples shown below; the toy-output directory does not currently contain these plots

The calling routes produce aligned BAM files and either gene-level or transcript-level expression estimates. The cohort-level route produces QC-passed and normalized expression matrices suitable for phenotype annotation and xQTL association testing.
